## 0 Configuration

```{r config}
# If config exists on disk, read it. Otherwise construct and save.
config_path <- "PHASE_config.rds"

if (file.exists(config_path)) {
  config <- readRDS(config_path)
} else {
  config <- list(
    phase_name    = "XX_phase_name",
    seed          = 2025L,
    input_paths   = c(
      corpus = "../../data-raw/INPUTFILE.rds"
    ),
    output_paths  = c(
      result = "../../data/OUTPUTFILE.rds"
    ),
    parameters    = list(
      # Phase-specific parameters here
    ),
    dictionary_paths = c(
      destinations = "../../dictionaries/destinations.csv",
      registers    = "../../dictionaries/registers.csv"
    )
  )
  saveRDS(config, config_path)
}
```

## 8 Decision gate

```{r gate}
# source("../../R/decision_gate.R")
# Define checks and evaluate
gate_results <- list(
  # check_name = list(status = "PASS|FAIL|CAUTION", message = "details")
)

for (check in names(gate_results)) {
  cat(sprintf("[%s] %s: %s\n",
    gate_results[[check]]$status,
    check,
    gate_results[[check]]$message
  ))
}
```
